scope: B1 prompt-projection distillation: train explicit Wt[128,2560] / Wv[128,1024] from a dense teacher; no untrained random weight may enter inference

loss.note: main loss is listwise KL(teacher_soft || softmax(student/T)) scaled by T^2; score MSE is off unless score_mse_weight > 0

optim.note: model selection uses the val split only; the test split is evaluated once after the best epoch is frozen

split.assignment: sha256(salt|seed|source_image_sha256) mapped to [0,1) with cumulative train/val/test thresholds; every sample sharing an image hash gets the same split
split.forbidden: independent per-sample_id split is forbidden for formal training; a missing/empty image hash is a hard error

hardware_constrained.matched_real_budget: for each budget K, R = real_group_count; compare source_type==REAL selected groups against teacher top-R recall/jaccard/saliency-mass (fair real-vs-real comparison)
hardware_constrained.total_budget_coverage: for each budget K, compare source_type==REAL selected groups against teacher top-K recall/jaccard/saliency-mass; context groups occupy part of K so this is an upper-bound coverage, explicitly not a full score

l2_baseline.score: per-group L2 norm of group_mean; equals evaluation.hardware_regular_token_selector.group_l2_saliency on the [G,4,1024] broadcast
l2_baseline.purpose: no-training baseline the formal projection must beat on val

shuffled_prompt.assignment: within each split, sort sample_id ascending and give sample i the prompt embeddings of sample i+1 modulo n
shuffled_prompt.score: same Wt/Wv as the correct student
shuffled_prompt.determinism: depends only on the sorted sample_ids and their prompt embeddings
shuffled_prompt.unavailable_when: split sample count < 2; reported as unavailable, never fabricated

promotion_criteria.val_beats_l2: on the val split, student_correct must be strictly better than l2_baseline on every primary metric
promotion_criteria.val_correct_beats_shuffled: on the val split, student_correct must be strictly better than student_shuffled_prompt on every primary metric
promotion_criteria.no_arbitrary_threshold: no numeric margin is fixed a priori; the sign of the paired delta is the criterion
promotion_criteria.test_discipline: the test split is evaluated exactly once after the best epoch is frozen; test never influences selection or hyperparameters

teacher.encoder: full dense vision tower (all 24 blocks) + merger

student.input: per-group mean of the 4 patch positions [G,1024]
student.projection: Wt[128,2560] prompt, Wv[128,1024] visual; y = features @ W.T
student.weights: must be trained before export/load; never random at inference

manifest.note: frozen CV-Bench-independent corpus (236 COCO images / 472 records) built by evaluation/prompt_projection_clean_inductive.py; the extractor fails closed unless --manifest resolves to this exact relative path and sha256

extraction.source_image_sha256: streaming SHA256 of the raw source image file bytes; written to both the npz metadata and the JSONL index and used to group the split
extraction.forbidden_payload: any full dense hidden state, block0 per-patch hidden, deepstack or merged embeddings
extraction.resume: JSONL index; sample_ids already indexed are skipped

gpu_gate.owner_rule: every GPU compute process must belong to the current user
gpu_gate.on_failure: write audit JSON and exit without loading any model

shared_gpu_policy.supersedes: the strict 24 GiB exclusive-owner gate for the 2026-09-28 'actually-runnable first' authorization; the legacy report is kept and annotated as superseded
shared_gpu_policy.other_users_processes: read-only nvidia-smi/ps only; never killed, paused or modified
shared_gpu_policy.default_without_flag: legacy strict owner rule plus required_free_mib=20480 unchanged

definitions.teacher_raw: for each merged group g, max over prompt tokens t of cosine(merged_embeddings[g], prompt_embeddings[t])
definitions.teacher_normalized: min-max of teacher_raw over the G groups of one sample
definitions.teacher_soft_target: softmax(teacher_normalized / temperature) over groups; sums to 1
definitions.student_raw: for each group g, max over prompt tokens t of cosine(group_mean[g] @ Wv.T, prompt_embeddings[t] @ Wt.T)
definitions.ndcg_at_k: graded NDCG@K using teacher_scores_normalized as relevance, ranked by student_raw
definitions.spearman: Pearson correlation of average ranks (stable sort, no SciPy)
definitions.l2_baseline: rank groups by the per-group L2 norm of group_mean and compute the same rank/K metrics
definitions.shuffled_prompt: rank groups by student scores computed with cyclically mismatched prompt embeddings inside the same split
definitions.hardware_matched_real_budget: R = real_group_count; selected source_type==REAL groups vs teacher top-R
definitions.hardware_total_budget_coverage: selected source_type==REAL groups vs teacher top-K; upper-bound coverage because context groups share K
